title: App shell
description: Signed-in app frame shared by several routes: sidebar with nested nav groups and the current route highlighted, header with breadcrumb, account or workspace menu and command palette, phone drawer

quality.mount: Mount the shell once, in the `layout.tsx` of the routes it frames, and read the route with `usePathname()`; a shell rendered by each page loses its open groups and collapsed state on every navigation
quality.current: `selectNavHref` picks the highlighted item and opens the group that holds it
quality.collapse: A collapsed sidebar keeps every item reachable: icons with a tooltip or aria-label, the group label as the icon's name
quality.phone: At s the sidebar hides and a header button opens the same nav in a left Drawer; following a link closes it
quality.header: Breadcrumbs from the route, and the account or workspace switcher as a DropdownWrapper or UserMenu with Option rows
